title: Device Simulation - response  (server -> firmware)
description: Roadmap #251 modality A. System.Text.Json serialization of api.Models.DeviceSimulation, returned by GET /api/Device/Simulation only when Simulation Mode is enabled for the polling device (DeviceApiController.DeviceSimulationPoll) - the server answers HTTP 204 with no body otherwise, so firmware never has to parse an all-null object just to learn there is nothing to override. A non-null metric field replaces that reading before SensorController hands values to ActuatorController's rule evaluation; a null field means 'use the real reading'. Credentials travel as HTTP HEADERS: 'apiId' and 'Authorization' (apiAuth token) - same rule as GET/POST on every other device-facing endpoint.

enabled.description: Always true on this response - the endpoint returns 204 instead of enabled:false.

liquidPH.description: C# property is 'LiquidPH'; camelCase leaves the 'PH' suffix uppercase -> 'liquidPH', same as deviceConfigSensor.sensorPH in config.response.schema.json.
